# `Annotate`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Annotation workflow notification (start, result, failure) from the direct sender or the function detail.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, SendAnnotateEvent @0x200a90, StartSolveImg @0x1fbb90, StartAnnotate @0x1fb0b0, RefreshSolveStatusFunc @0x207000 (64-bit build); F family helpers |

Direct annotation notifier sends start, complete (with result) or fail (error, code) with page and tag; the F detail follows the function-state family: Function-state family (F): the event formatter formats the named function detail. state is always present; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms while the timer runs or at a terminal state; error and code at fail (even when the stored code is zero; lookup failure gives 'fail to operate'); cancel omits code and error; route is optional function ancestry. The sender does no deduplication and needs no preceding working event. Detail flags can suppress the working or non-working sends while the cached function tree still changes, so a receiver can miss transitions. The annotation result object is open: APK 3.3.2 has consumer DTOs for it, but those are expectations, not firmware members, and are not listed here. Channel I (TCP 4700). Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. Producer scope: only annotation runs (start_annotate, or the automatic annotation after a capture) send it; start_solve resets the solve parameters, which clears the annotate flag, so a solve it starts reports only through PlateSolve. The event carries no request id, and tag is the latest tag set by any solve or annotation, so a client correlates by timing.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"Annotate"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Union. F: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Direct annotation notifier: start, complete, fail. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if stage string non-empty | - | Only when the detail holds a non-empty stage string; value set unresolved. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds (signed 32-bit low bits): current monotonic time minus start while working or started-but-unfinished, otherwise end minus start. Independent of Timestamp. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail | - | Message for code. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail | - | Stored error code; present at fail even when zero. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Function-ancestry names at send time (for example View, Stack); may be absent. Not an address. [READ] |
| `page` | string | if direct producer | - | Legacy/direct producer: source page. [READ] |
| `tag` | string | if direct producer and tag non-empty | - | Source tag, only when non-empty. It is a single global, also overwritten by internal block solves, so it identifies the latest solve or annotation rather than a request. [READ] |
| `result` | object | if direct complete | - | Annotation helper JSON, embedded as an object. Its complete firmware member set is unresolved; tolerate any members. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, start - Direct start (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Annotate","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"start","page":"preview","tag":"example"}
```

Event, complete - Direct result (READ shape; result members invented placeholders):

```json
{"Event":"Annotate","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","page":"preview","tag":"example","result":{"image_id":41}}
```
